hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" 2>/dev/null; recent=$(git log --since="30 minutes ago" --name-only --pretty=format: 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^$" | grep -vE "INSIGHTS\.md$"); uncommitted=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -vE "INSIGHTS\.md$"); if [ -n "$recent" ] || [ -n "$uncommitted" ]; then jq -n "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"Stop\",additionalContext:\"Reminder (engineering-insights hook): source files changed recently in this repo. Before finishing, check whether a non-trivial, actionable engineering lesson surfaced this session and, if so, invoke the engineering-insights skill / update the relevant module INSIGHTS.md. If nothing new cleared the bar, doing nothing is the correct outcome.\"}}"; fi

input=$(cat)
cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""')
if ! echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|]|&&)\s*(gh pr create|git push)\b'; then
  exit 0
fi
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" 2>/dev/null || exit 0
STATE=".claude/pr-self-review.local.md"
deny() {
  jq -n --arg reason "$1" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$reason}}'
  exit 0
}
[ -f "$STATE" ] || deny "pr-self-review has not been run yet. Run /pr-self-review before opening a PR or pushing."
CUR_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)
CUR_HASH=$( (git diff HEAD; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard) | shasum | awk '{print $1}')
REC_SHA=$(grep '^sha:' "$STATE" | head -1 | awk '{print $2}')
REC_HASH=$(grep '^worktree_hash:' "$STATE" | head -1 | awk '{print $2}')
REC_VERDICT=$(grep '^verdict:' "$STATE" | head -1 | awk '{print $2}')
if [ "$CUR_SHA" != "$REC_SHA" ] || [ "$CUR_HASH" != "$REC_HASH" ]; then
  deny "pr-self-review verdict is stale (commit or working tree changed since last run). Run /pr-self-review again."
fi
if [ "$REC_VERDICT" != "CLEAR" ]; then
  deny "pr-self-review verdict is BLOCKED. Fix CRITICAL findings and re-run /pr-self-review."
fi
exit 0
